يستقدسون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْدِسُونَ (yastaqdisūna) /jas.taq.di.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
# يُسْتَقْدَسُونَ (yustaqdasūna) /jus.taq.da.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
